results.snippet: Resumes & Cover Letters  # How to Tailor Your Resume to a Job Description  Tailor your resume to a job description without keyword stuffing. Use this step-by-step workflow, examples, checklist, and AI prompt to make your experience match the role.  Tailoring your resume to a job description means matching your real experience to the role's most important requirements. You are not rewriting your entire career history, copying the job post, or adding skills you do not have. You are making the relevant parts of your background easier for a recruiter, hiring manager, and applicant tracking system
